jobs.title: Insights & Analytics Lead - North America
jobs.description:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

**How does this role contribute to our collective success?**  
Data, analytics and AI are critical enablers of AXIS' strategic ambitions. The Insights & Analytics Lead – North America will be a hands-on technical leader who turns business questions into high-quality insights, analytical solutions and clear recommendations for North American underwriting teams.  
This role is responsible for translating business requirements into well-defined data, analytics, data science and AI requirements. You will explore and analyse large and complex data sets, identify trends and opportunities, determine the most appropriate analytical approach, and communicate conclusions in ways that support better, faster and more informed decisions.  
Working within an agile delivery model, you will partner closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Architects and Technology experts to design, test and deliver solutions that are practical, scalable and aligned to measurable business outcomes.  
Reporting to the Insights & Analytics Director – North America, you will combine technical depth, business understanding and strong delivery skills. You will provide day-to-day technical leadership on initiatives while remaining personally involved in analysis, solution design and the development of analytical outputs.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Translate Business Needs into Analytical and AI Requirements  
  Partner with North American underwriting and business teams to understand business objectives, decision points, pain points and opportunities.
* Translate business requirements into clear data, analytics, data science and AI requirements, including hypotheses, data needs, analytical methods, success measures and delivery acceptance criteria.
* Challenge and refine requests to ensure the proposed solution addresses the underlying business problem and is proportionate to the value and complexity involved.
* Recommend the right approach for each problem, whether descriptive or diagnostic analysis, reporting and visualisation, predictive modelling, machine learning, generative AI or workflow automation.
* Deliver Hands-On Analysis and Insight
* Frame analytical questions, develop hypotheses, select appropriate methods and validate findings before drawing conclusions.
* Convert analysis into practical recommendations, explaining the business implications, limitations and actions required.
* Identify opportunities where advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities could improve underwriting effectiveness, portfolio management, operational efficiency or customer outcomes.
* Shape solution concepts and technical requirements, including use cases, user journeys, required data, model or AI behaviour, controls, evaluation criteria and expected business value.
* Rapidly prototype analytical and AI-enabled solutions to test feasibility and value before wider development.
* Work with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to support model development, testing, validation, deployment and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Ensure solutions are explainable, fit-for-purpose and developed in line with AXIS data, AI governance, security and responsible AI requirements.
* Work as an active member of cross-functional agile delivery teams, partnering closely with Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Architects, Technology experts and business product owners.
* Contribute technical analysis, solution design, backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, demonstrations, testing and retrospectives.
* Promote reuse of common data products, analytical methods, models and components across the wider Insights & Analytics community.
* Define and track outcome-focused success measures, using feedback and performance evidence to improve solutions after release.
* Explain analytical and AI concepts in clear business language and build confidence in the appropriate use of data-driven insights.

**Success Measures**  
Success in this role will be measured through:

* Delivered solutions contribute to measurable improvements in underwriting effectiveness, portfolio insight, operational efficiency or customer outcomes.
* Solutions use the right level of analytical sophistication for the problem and are practical, explainable and fit-for-purpose.
* Strong collaboration and trusted working relationships are established across North America business teams, Data & Analytics and Technology.
* Insights and solutions are adopted and used within day-to-day business decisions and workflows.
* Analytical assets, methods and components are documented, reusable and continuously improved.

**About you:**  
We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table. While there are qualifications and experiences we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might help you fulfil this role and contribute to our goals

As a provider of customized supply chain solutions, we serve customers in many business-to-business market segments including restaurants, grocery stores, healthcare, sports and entertainment, and cruise lines.
  
  
**You will:**  

* Conduct competitive compensation analysis to determine classification and appropriate salary range using relevant market survey data while considering internal equity.

* Proficiency with compensation market pricing and survey tools, including Salary.com CompAnalyst or comparable benchmarking platforms.
* Knowledge of compensation practices supporting both hourly and salaried employee populations across multiple job families and organizational levels.

* Strong technical knowledge of Excel is required, including the ability to develop spreadsheets with formulas, functions, pivot tables, and lookups.

The role will be based in Whippany, NJ with the expectation of a hybrid work model.

**Institutional Client Group:**

The Global Client Group (GCG) is responsible for driving the firm’s strategy and business development efforts with institutional investors and consultants, globally. The Insurance team, part of MetLife Investment Management’s (MIM’s) Global Client Group, oversees $126 billion in assets under management across over 150 insurance clients invested across MIM’s platform in public and private assets, which represents 39% of MIM’s unaffiliated client AUM.

**The Role:**

The Insurance Relationship Manager analyst will be a client facing role, working with Insurance GCG members, investment professionals across Public Fixed Income, Private Fixed Income Real Estate, Alternatives, and other key stakeholders such as MIM’s Insurance Asset Management team to provide proactive, focused client service to insurance clients. The Insurance Relationship Manager analyst will support senior relationship managers on client accounts, often quarterbacking client deliverables and initiatives internally and externally.

**Key Relationships:**

* Reports to: Senior Relationship Manager, Managing Director - Insurance
* Direct reports/team: None
* Key Stakeholders: Global Co-Heads of Insurance, Insurance Relationship Managers, investment and functional support teams across MIM

**Horizon Media** , founded in 1989 by Bill Koenigsberg, is recognized as one of the most innovative marketing and advertising firms. * A problem solver with the ability to develop creative solutions

jobs.description:
**Senior Project Manager, R&D & Marketing Operations**
------------------------------------------------------

### **Position Snapshot**

* **Job Title:** Senior Project Manager, R&D & Marketing Operations
* **Department:** Operations / R&D / Marketing
* **Location:** On-site in Inwood, NY, directly across the Queens border from Far Rockaway and minutes from the Far Rockaway-Mott Avenue A train terminal. In close proximity to JFK Airport.
* **Schedule:** Full-time, Monday-Friday, onsite 5 days per week
* **Compensation:** $95,000-$120,000 per year, based on directly relevant experience, education, and systems expertise.

Rockville is seeking a Senior Project Manager, R&D & Marketing Operations to help build and run the project management structure behind our R&D, product development, marketing, ecommerce, and cross-functional business priorities.

This is a hands-on project management role for someone who is highly experienced with ClickUp, highly adept at using AI tools and AI agents, strong in communication, and capable of helping a fast-moving business create more structure, visibility, accountability, and follow-through without slowing the team down.

The right person is not simply a task tracker. We need someone who can understand what matters to senior leadership, translate priorities into clear workflows and dashboards, run effective project meetings, follow up assertively across departments, and help teams keep projects moving with less confusion and more accountability.

Rockville is an online retailer specializing in high-quality audio equipment across multiple categories, including car audio, marine audio, pro audio, DJ equipment, recording equipment, lighting, speakers, amplifiers, subwoofers, microphones, mixers, monitors, accessories, components, and related products. Our business moves quickly, with projects running across product development, R&D, marketing, ecommerce, content, data, customer experience, and operations. We need a project manager who can bring structure, visibility, and follow-through to that environment.

Our facility is located in Inwood, NY, directly across the Queens border from Far Rockaway and minutes from the Far Rockaway-Mott Avenue A train terminal. Many members of our team commute from Queens and Brooklyn via the A train.

### **What Makes This Role Stand Out**

* **Project management infrastructure:** Help standardize uniformity of practical project management structure for a growing business, including intake, prioritization, meeting cadence, status reporting, accountability, and executive visibility.
* **ClickUp ownership:** Build, configure, maintain, and improve ClickUp workflows, dashboards, automations, templates, task structures, statuses, custom fields, dependencies, and reporting views.
* **AI-forward project operations:** Use AI tools, AI agents, and automation to improve follow-up, reporting, task organization, meeting notes, project visibility, workflow efficiency, and administrative leverage.
* **R&D and Marketing impact:** Support project flow across product development, R&D, marketing, ecommerce, content, creative, data, and related cross-functional initiatives.
* **Executive visibility:** Translate leadership priorities into simple dashboards and status views that show what is moving, what is blocked, what is late, and what needs attention.
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Work across departments, personalities, and communication styles to keep people aligned, remove confusion, and drive follow-through.

### **What You’ll Own**

* Own day-to-day administration and improvement of ClickUp for R&D, Marketing, and related cross-functional project work.
* Configure and maintain workflows, statuses, task templates, custom fields, automations, dependencies, recurring tasks, dashboards, and reporting views.
* Use AI tools and AI agents to streamline project updates, summarize meetings, organize follow-ups, identify blockers, improve reporting, and reduce manual administrative work.
* Build executive-ready dashboards that show project health, overdue items, blocked work, priority deliverables, risks, missed deadlines, resource concerns, and items requiring leadership attention.
* Manage project intake, task setup, ownership, milestones, dependencies, approvals, follow-ups, status updates, and documentation standards.
* Support R&D projects by tracking product development milestones, testing activity, documentation, handoffs, approvals, blockers, priority changes, and completion status.

jobs.title: Global Technology Strategy, Analyst
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

The Global Technology (GT) organization at JPMorganChase is a world-class technology team of 65,000+ technologists across 20+ technology hubs worldwide with $20B+ in annual technology investment. GT develops high-quality technology products and solutions for JPMC's millions of clients and customers, and 320,000+ employees—everything from employee and infrastructure platforms to big data and mobile solutions, innovations in agentic / generative AI, electronic payments, cybersecurity, machine learning, cloud development, and more.

The Global Technology Strategy (GTS) team is an internal management consulting team that works closely with GT Leadership—the Firm's CIOs, CISO, CTO, and other senior technology leaders—to drive technology strategy, enable innovation, and solve the biggest technology problems across the firm. We work on several types of strategy projects, including problem sizing/solutioning, process reimagination, operating model and organizational design, firmwide transformation, and more, to help JPMC define how technology should be utilized to enable the firm's overall business strategy, including in areas such as AI/agentic, data strategy, technology infrastructure, line of business technology, product development lifecycle etc.

As an Analyst on the Global Technology Strategy team, you will utilize the strategy consulting toolkit—problem framing, critical thinking, analysis and synthesis, executive communication/narrative, stakeholder management, and more—to play a crucial role in defining and deconstructing technology problems for the organization. When someone joins the Global Technology Strategy team, they accelerate their career by working on high-impact and complex problems, learning and applying industry-leading technology practices, and becoming part of a highly collaborative team that prioritizes professional development and ownership.

* Support projects to resolve complex, cross-cutting, executive-level problems faced by the GT organization

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Knowledge of enterprise technologies and trends; ability to learn quickly as the technology landscape continues to rapidly evolve

IRIS Environmental Laboratories is an accredited environmental testing laboratory in Union, New Jersey. We serve environmental consultants, property managers, schools, healthcare facilities, and contractors. We are expanding our metals program and are looking for a senior analyst to own it.

**Position Summary**  
The Senior ICP-OES Analyst leads the lab’s inorganic metals program on an Agilent 5110 SVDV ICP-OES. The role covers drinking water, non-potable water, and solid, wipe, and air-filter matrices under EPA Methods 200.5, 200.7, and SW-846 6010D. You will run and review routine analyses, maintain method compliance under TNI/NELAP and AIHA-LAP quality systems, keep the instrument performing, and train and mentor metals staff.

* Routine experience performing EPA 200.7 and/or 6010 series methods. EPA 200.5 experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with acid and/or microwave digestion of water and solid matrices.
* Working knowledge of TNI/NELAP, ISO/IEC 17025, or equivalent quality systems.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot instruments and resolve QC failures independently.
* Strong documentation habits and attention to detail.
* Ability to work on-site in Union, NJ.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Agilent ICP-OES and ICP Expert software.

jobs.description:
We have many opportunities available on our other career site pages. Click here to link to our careers page!

Our banner is part of Signet Jewelers, a purpose-driven company who believes love inspires love and whose mission it is to enable all people to Celebrate Life and Express Love. Signet Jewelers is also a “Great Place to Work-Certified™” company. Innovation and brilliance – two things that set us apart. Join us!

The Analyst, Supply Chain Planning is responsible for providing the analytical foundation on which our demand, supply, and inventory decisions are made, and for driving the improvement initiatives that advance our planning capability over time. This role sits within the Planning team alongside our demand and supply planners: where they own the execution of the forecast and the replenishment plan, you own the analysis, diagnostics, and reporting that make those decisions sharper, faster, and more defensible. You will build and automate the recurring performance reporting the team runs on, investigate and explain variance rather than simply surface it, and translate large, complex datasets into recommendations leadership can act on. This position offers broad exposure across forecasting, replenishment, and inventory strategy, and a direct path to grow into a planning or analytics leadership role as our team's scope expands.  
  
One of the first tactical initiatives for this role will be building out our store sales performance and replenishment analytics. As our retail showroom footprint grows alongside e-commerce, we need clear visibility into how each location sells, where availability is constraining sales, and how inventory should be allocated and replenished across the network.  
  
You will own the analysis that establishes that visibility and turns it into a repeatable replenishment approach. We are a hands-on, code-forward planning organization. Our forecasting, replenishment, and reporting run on a Python-native analytics stack rather than on manual spreadsheets, and every member of the team is expected to work fluently in SQL, Python, and BI tooling. This is how we operate, and it is central to how this role creates value.  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Analytics, Reporting & Performance Management
* Build, automate, and maintain the recurring reporting and dashboards the Planning team operates on, including forecast accuracy and bias, service level and fill rate, inventory turns, weeks of supply, replenishment health, and fulfilment mix Extract, clean, and reconcile data across multiple source systems into trustworthy, decision-ready views, applying disciplined validation before any number is published
* Define and track planning KPIs against target, developing exception reporting that surfaces risk early rather than after the fact
* Investigate variance to root cause and explain the drivers behind it, distinguishing genuine demand signal from data quality, seasonality, and one-off effects
* Prepare the analytical inputs and supporting materials for the weekly planning cycle and the monthly IBP cadence

**Demand & Supply Planning Support**

  

* Partner day to day with the demand and supply planners, providing the data, backtests, and diagnostics required to make better forecasting and replenishment decisions
* Support forecast review by quantifying forecast value add, benchmarking model output against naive baselines, and identifying where statistical output requires human override
* Analyze demand patterns across categories and channels, including seasonality, promotional lift, new product introduction, and clearance behavior
* Model the service level and working capital implications of proposed planning decisions to support tradeoff discussions

**Store Sales Performance & Replenishment**

  

* Build the reporting and analysis that establishes clear visibility into store level sales performance, including sell-through, productivity by location, category mix, and performance against plan
* Analyze store inventory position and availability, quantifying lost sales opportunity where stock outs or thin coverage are constraining sell-through
* Develop and refine store replenishment logic, including model stock, reorder triggers, and allocation rules across locations
* Support allocation decisions for new product introduction, seasonal ranges, and high-demand SKUs across the store network
* Compare demand signal and inventory productivity across store and e-commerce channels to inform how inventory is positioned across the network
* Establish the recurring store performance and replenishment reporting cadence, and evolve it from initial build into standard operating process

**Inventory & Assortment Analysis**

  

* Support inventory strategy analysis across finished jewelry and, as the team's scope expands, component and factory inventory: what to carry, how much, and where
* Analyze inventory health including aging, coverage, excess and obsolescence risk, and availability gaps, and recommend corrective action
* Contribute to assortment and SKU rationalization analysis, quantifying the sales and working capital impact of range changes
* Assess fulfilment method performance across our asset, vendor-stocked, and just-in-time models, and identify opportunities to improve availability and speed

**Continuous Improvement & Automation**

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

  

**Exciting Opportunity at MSK:** Revenue Integrity Analyst II
  
  
At Memorial Sloan Kettering (MSK), our Revenue Integrity team plays a critical role in ensuring accurate coding, charge capture, compliance, and financial integrity, directly supporting MSK's mission to end cancer for life. The Revenue Integrity Analyst II serves as a coding and revenue cycle subject matter expert, partnering with clinical, coding, and operational teams to optimize charging workflows, maintain regulatory compliance, and strengthen reimbursement outcomes across the organization.

  

**Role Overview**

  

* Serve as a subject matter expert on revenue integrity, charge capture, diagnostic coding, and billing compliance.

* Perform comprehensive reviews of Charge Description Master (CDM) records to ensure coding accuracy, compliance, and ongoing integrity.

* Investigate coding and charging discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement standardized corrective actions.

* Manage and resolve Revenue Integrity tickets related to coding edits, charge capture issues, CDM maintenance, and billing discrepancies while maintaining clear audit trails.

* Partner with Diagnostic Coding teams, including Radiology and Pathology coders, to ensure accurate application of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, and HCPCS coding guidelines.

* Evaluate Epic work queues, coding edits, and charge review reports to identify reimbursement risks and revenue leakage opportunities.

* Collaborate with Revenue Operations, HIM, Billing, and Clinical departments on quarterly and annual coding updates and regulatory changes.

* Educate clinical departments and operational stakeholders on coding requirements, charge capture accuracy, documentation standards, and compliant billing practices.

Present coding audit findings, revenue integrity trends, and process improvement recommendations to leadership and governance committees.  

  

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant healthcare revenue cycle experience.

* Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS, charge capture processes, and billing compliance requirements especially related to LCD NCD regulations.

* Professional coding certification required or strongly preferred, including CPC, COC, CCS, RHIA, or RHIT.

* Experience collaborating with coding, HIM, revenue cycle, finance, and clinical teams within a complex healthcare environment.

* Demonstrated experience analyzing coding edits, denials, charge reconciliation issues, and reimbursement impacts.

Epic experience and familiarity with revenue cycle applications, coding work queues, and charge review tools preferred.  

  

**Core Skills**

  

* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to identify coding trends, documentation gaps, workflow deficiencies, and compliance risks.

* Strong understanding of healthcare reimbursement methodologies, coding regulations, and revenue cycle operations.

* Ability to communicate complex coding and revenue integrity concepts clearly to clinical, operational, and leadership audiences.

* Proven ability to conduct coding education, training, and audit feedback sessions that drive sustainable improvements.

Strong organizational, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills with a focus on accuracy, accountability, and continuous process improvement.

**SUMMARY:**

VISIONS/Services for the Blind and Visually Impaired seeks an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst – Government Contracts to join its Finance and Administration team. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer, the Senior Financial Analyst will have primary responsibility for the day-to-day fiscal management and financial monitoring of VISIONS government-funded programs, with particular emphasis on contracts with NYC Aging and the New York State Commission for the Blind (NYSCB).

The position will work closely with the CFO, program leadership and other members of the Finance team to ensure that contract budgets are accurate, expenditures are appropriately allocated, invoices and claims are submitted timely, and VISIONS maximizes available government funding while remaining in compliance with funder requirements.

The ideal candidate combines strong financial analysis and budgeting skills with hands-on experience managing New York City and/or New York State government contracts and financial systems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Government Contract Financial Management

* Manage the fiscal components of assigned NYC and New York State government contracts, with particular responsibility for NYC Aging and NYSCB-funded programs.

* Identify delayed or outstanding receivables and work with appropriate internal staff and government agencies to resolve issues.
* Maintain complete and accurate supporting documentation for contract expenses, invoices and fiscal reports.
* Assist with year-end contract closeouts and reconciliations.

Government Financial Systems

Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.

The Office of Housing Access and Stability (“HAS”) consists of the divisions of Housing Opportunity, Tenant and Owner Resources, Housing Stability, Budget and Program Operations, and Program Policy and Innovation. The mission of the office is to ensure fair, efficient, and transparent access to affordable housing. The Office provides subsidies, placement services, and tools that connect New Yorkers to affordable housing and ensures vulnerable households in subsidized housing have the support they need to be safely housed. Housing Access is committed to expanding housing choices, affirmatively furthering fair housing, and stabilizing the financial health of buildings.

jobs.title: Equity Research – Analyst/Associate, Airlines & Freight Transportation (New York)
jobs.description:
Research

Morgan Stanley Investment Research is uniquely committed to being an essential part of our clients' investment process. We strive to be the sell-side research provider that best understands the buy side. Through relevant and timely conversations with leading investors, we focus resources on risk-reward essentials: identifying the investor debates, assessing the potential outcomes, and uncovering the evidence our clients need to validate their investment decisions. Our equity analysts cover some 3,000 stocks; our economists, strategists and fixed income analysts cover all major regions and other asset classes around the globe.

  
  

Equity Research

The Equity Research department is responsible for researching macroeconomic and microeconomic conditions, along with company fundamentals. It also collects and analyses financial information to make investment recommendations on stocks in specific sectors. Research analysts build financial models to explore alternative scenarios, examine industries and communicate with companies and investors. Equity Research team members discuss their analysis and investment recommendations in research notes. A career in investment research at Morgan Stanley demands a commitment to excellence and a passion for the markets as well as the highest level of integrity.

  
  

We are seeking an experienced Analyst/Associate member to join our Airlines & Freight Transportation team in New York City.

The Airlines & Freight Transportation research team covers 30+ stocks across airlines, rails, trucking, parcels, and logistics. The team is known for differentiated, out-of-consensus views that balance timely tactical calls with deep thematic research, including work on technology-driven disruption such as autonomous trucks, drones, eVTOLs, and freight digitization, supported by a highly developed data and modeling platform.

  
  

Primary Responsibilities

* Create and maintain financial, valuation, and industry models, leveraging skills in accounting, finance, and economics

* Translate company, industry, consumer, market, and alternative data into insightful research reports with clear investment debates, differentiated conclusions, and actionable stock calls

* Develop and maintain relationships with management and investor relations teams of companies under coverage, industry specialists, and other key leaders of opinion

* Engage with institutional investors by responding to in-depth questions, addressing bespoke requests, discussing companies and investment theses, and helping communicate the team’s highest-conviction views

* Support internal sales and trading teams with timely analysis of sector breaking news and relevant industry developments

* Adopt and apply AI-enabled research tools judiciously to accelerate information gathering, model maintenance, data analysis, and workflow execution while maintaining analytical rigor, source verification, data integrity, and quality control

* Conduct industry diligence and primary research through surveys, expert conference calls, and channel checks to evaluate industry trends and their implications for companies under coverage

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to produce larger industry and thematic reports

  
  

Qualifications

* Ideally 1-2 years of professional experience in equity research or investment banking

* Experience or sector knowledge in airlines and/or freight transportation is highly desirable

* Proven experience using Excel to build and maintain financial models; advanced Excel proficiency is required

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis clearly, defend conclusions, and contribute positively in client-facing discussions

* Demonstrated interest in public markets and a genuine curiosity about what drives stock performance, investor debates, and valuation

* Comfort adopting AI-enabled tools and new technologies to improve research efficiency, with the judgment to verify outputs, protect data integrity, and apply tools appropriately

* Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

* Ability to adapt quickly and work well under pressure

* High EQ, strong personal drive, energy, creativity, intellectual curiosity, organizational discipline, and a team-oriented mindset

* Ability to think independently, develop differentiated views, and operate with a self-starter mentality

* Experience with Python is a plus but not required

* CFA designation, or progress toward CFA is a plus but not required

  
  

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

May handle confidential and sensitive information related to capital projects, departmental

personnel, and operations.

Strong analytical skills.

  

Self-motivated and detail-oriented.

  

Strong organizational, written, and oral communication skills.

  

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with all levels of management and team members.

  

Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with sound judgment and discretion.

  

Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (including Excel, Access, and PowerPoint).

Costello Medical is growing quickly through demand from both new and existing clients and we are therefore looking for candidates with prior experience in healthcare consulting who enjoy content delivery, as well as project and client management, to join us as Senior Analysts in our Value & Access and Rare Diseases teams.

**Value & Access****:** The Value & Access team is further divided into our Market Access and Health Economics teams. It plays a crucial role in ensuring new pharmaceuticals and medical devices are reimbursed and accessible to patients by creating evidence-based materials such as dossiers and slide decks, as well as health economic models, that highlight their clinical and economic value

**Rare Diseases****:** The Rare Diseases team plays a pivotal role in overcoming the challenges of limited treatments and evidence for the >10,000 rare diseases that have been identified. This involves regular interaction with clients over email and in meetings, including providing strategic advice, as well as internally, training and supervising the Costello Medical project team. Senior Analysts are central to the quality of project deliverables and so their role involves the review of work from more junior colleagues, and the provision of constructive feedback.

You will also play a key role in contributing to business development by identifying new clients, writing proposals for projects with new and existing clients, building and maintaining excellent client relationships, and identifying opportunities to provide additional services within existing projects.

You’ll collaborate closely with our experienced Boston-based Team Leads—each with 7–10+ years in the industry—and senior colleagues across North America and globally. new_jobs.title: Actuarial Analyst - Commercial P&C Insurance
new_jobs.description:
Come join our team!

There are many reasons why EPIC Insurance Brokers & Consultants has become one of the fastest-growing firms in the insurance industry. Fueled and driven by capable, committed people who share common beliefs and values and "bring it" every day, EPIC is always looking for people who have "the right stuff" – people who know what they want and aren't afraid to make it happen.

Headquartered in New York City and founded in 2007, our company has over 4,000 employees nationwide. With locations spread out across the U.S., our local market knowledge and industry expertise helps support our clients' regional and global needs. We have grown very quickly since our founding, and we continue to see growth and success thanks to our hard-working and growth-minded employees.

Our core values are: Owner mindset, Inspire trust, Think big, and Drive results. If these values and growth align with what you're looking for in your next career? Then consider joining our amazing team!

  

**JOB OVERVIEW:**

We're hiring an **Actuary** to build the pricing models behind our property insurance work, as well as working on casualty lines. You'll build, validate, and maintain actuarial and CAT models that tell us what property insurance should cost for our clients, and you'll turn that output into recommendations our brokers can use with risk managers and CFOs. **Current Property experience is preferred but not required; however must have property pricing & modeling experience at some point in career.**

This is a hands-on modeling job. Most of your week will be spent in the data (policy info, exposures, loss runs) building and refining models that help brokers benchmark risk, sanity-check pricing, and advise clients heading into renewal. ACAS is preferred but not required. If you're a non-credentialed actuary with real property modeling chops, we want to talk to you.  
If you like building property pricing models and want to see your work change how clients buy insurance, this one is for you.  
  
**LOCATION:** Hybrid - open to 3 to 5 days a week in any of the following EPIC Office locations: New York City; San Francisco; Seattle.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**  

* Build, validate, and maintain the actuarial and statistical models we use to price property risk, both CAT and non-CAT.
* Work with a collaborative group of 10+ actuaries, geographically dispersed, with a core group located in NYC.
* Use those models to produce indicated rates, layer pricing, limit adequacy reads, retention analysis, and TCOR views that feed real placement decisions.
* Get hands-on with the data. That means cleaning up SOVs, loss runs, and policy schedules, and setting up workflows so the next analysis is faster than the last one.
* Turn model output into something a client can read. Think slides, benchmarks, and short written narratives our brokers can put in front of a CFO without translating.
* Sit with producers, property practice leaders, and clients to walk through the numbers, take the hard questions, and help shape program structure.
* Pitch in on new business. Request for Proposals, prospect meetings, and any deliverable where the actuarial story matters.
* Use AI to move faster and to push back on your own work. We expect you to lean on AI tools for the grunt work (data cleanup, first-pass code, drafting client narratives) and to stress-test your models with it: poke holes in assumptions, run sanity checks, and pressure-test results before they go out the door.
* Keep your models documented and auditable so anyone on the team can pick them up.

**TOOLS YOU'LL USE:**  

* Modeling & Simulation: @RISK, ModelRisk
* CAT Platforms: Moody's RMS, Verisk AIR, Archipelago
* Data & Programming: Excel, VBA, Python, R
* Visualization & Mapping: Power BI, Tableau, ArcGIS
* Market Intelligence: S&P Capital IQ
* Presentations: PowerPoint
* AI: Copilot, Claude

You won't necessarily use all of these on day one. But if you've touched most of them, you'll ramp up fast.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**  
Credentials & Technical Skills  

* ACAS is preferred. If you're not credentialed, we'll still seriously consider you with at least 2 years of dedicated commercial insurance pricing or modeling work.
* Real property modeling experience. You've worked on loss development, trend, frequency/severity, CAT load integration, and layer pricing, not just read about them.
* Comfort with big, messy datasets. Strong Excel is table stakes. You also work in at least one of Python, R, or SQL.
* You use AI in your day-to-day. Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, whatever fits the job. You know where it saves you hours, and you know when not to trust it.
* You can explain your work without jargon. If you can't get a broker or a client to follow the logic, the model doesn't matter.

Experience & Education  

* 2+ years of actuarial work, with meaningful time spent on property pricing or modeling.
* Bachelors in actuarial science, math, stats, or another quantitative field.
* Brokerage, reinsurance, or carrier-side property pricing experience is a big plus. Bonus points if you've seen how actuarial work actually moves a placement.
* Self-starter mindset. Our property analytics practice is growing fast, and we need people who want to help build it, not just slot into a process.

Domain  

* You understand commercial property: how programs are structured, what a tower looks like, what TIV values actually represent, and the actuarial logic underneath it all.
* You know the major CAT models (AIR, RMS) and how vendor output gets folded into pricing. Hands-on experience is great but not required.
* You've seen benchmarking, limit adequacy work, and TCOR modeling used in real renewal conversations.
* You're comfortable with complex programs: layered placements, quota shares, deductibles, self-insured retentions, and captives.
* You can work across a lot of stakeholders at once: brokers, practice leaders, clients, and the technical team.

  

**COMPENSATION:**

**Job Summary**

Precision ABA Therapy is seeking an experienced and motivated **Clinical Director (BCBA)** to oversee clinical assessment and insurance authorization processes for our Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy services.

The primary responsibilities of this position include conducting initial ABA assessments for new clients, developing individualized treatment plans, preparing and submitting insurance authorization requests, and ensuring timely completion of clinical documentation.

The ideal candidate will have strong clinical assessment skills, extensive knowledge of ABA treatment planning, and experience navigating insurance authorization requirements. This individual will play a key role in ensuring clients receive appropriate services while maintaining compliance with payer requirements, professional standards, and applicable regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**

Initial ABA Assessments

* Conduct initial ABA assessments for new clients, including comprehensive evaluations of developmental, behavioral, communication, adaptive, and functional skills, as appropriate.
* Complete functional behavior assessments when clinically indicated.
* Develop individualized ABA treatment plans based on assessment findings, client needs, and measurable treatment goals.
* Establish appropriate treatment recommendations, service intensity, and hours based on clinical necessity and assessment results.
* Prepare comprehensive assessment reports and supporting clinical documentation for insurance submission.
* Update treatment plans as required by insurance providers and applicable standards.
* Collaborate with parents, caregivers, and other professionals to gather relevant clinical information and support treatment planning.

Insurance Authorizations & Utilization Review

* Take primary responsibility for the ABA insurance authorization process.
* Prepare, submit, and track initial authorization requests for new clients.
* Complete and submit reauthorization requests, continued-service reviews, and requests for additional treatment hours.
* Ensure all authorization submissions include the required assessments, treatment plans, progress reports, and supporting documentation.
* Communicate with insurance companies, utilization review teams, and case managers regarding pending requests and clinical requirements.
* Monitor authorization expiration dates and submission deadlines to minimize interruptions in client services.
* Respond to requests for additional information and assist with peer-to-peer reviews, reconsiderations, and appeals when needed.
* Maintain accurate records of approved hours, authorization periods, submission dates, and authorization status.
* Review payer specific guidelines to ensure documentation meets medical necessity and coverage requirements.

Clinical Oversight, Session Note Reviews & Treatment Compliance

* Oversee the clinical review of ABA session notes to ensure documentation is accurate, complete, clinically appropriate, and compliant with insurance payer requirements.
* Review session notes submitted by BCBAs, RBTs, and other clinical staff to verify that services delivered align with authorized treatment plans and approved service hours.
* Ensure session documentation includes appropriate descriptions of interventions, client responses, progress toward treatment goals, and data collection, as applicable.
* Monitor compliance with treatment plan requirements, behavior intervention protocols, and individualized clinical recommendations.
* Verify that clinical documentation supports medical necessity and meets payer-specific billing and documentation standards.
* Identify incomplete, inaccurate, or noncompliant session notes and ensure corrections are completed within established deadlines.

**Skills**

* Previous experience as a Clinical Director, Clinical Supervisor, or Lead BCBA in an ABA therapy organization.
* Experience with commercial insurance plans and Medicaid ABA programs.
* Familiarity with functional behavior assessments, adaptive behavior assessments, and evidence based ABA treatment planning.
* Experience with peer-to-peer reviews, insurance denials, reconsiderations, and appeals.
* Experience coordinating clinical intake, assessments, and authorization workflows for new clients.
* Demonstrated experience conducting initial ABA assessments and developing individualized treatment plans.
* Experience preparing and submitting insurance authorizations for ABA therapy services.
* Strong organizational, communication, and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assessments, authorization requests, and deadlines simultaneously.

We are looking for a dependable professional who takes ownership of their responsibilities and is committed to helping families access timely, high quality ABA services.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Lakewood, NJ 08701

new_jobs.title: Lead Product Analyst, Content Supply & Understanding
new_jobs.description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

**Culture at Scribd, Inc.**
---------------------------

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

**The team.** Data & Analytics at Scribd brings together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Product Analytics to turn fragmented data and inconsistent definitions into trusted foundations, and to build AI-assisted tools that bring reliable intelligence into how teams make decisions.

**The role.** This role supports Content Supply & Understanding, the team that owns Scribd’s library of more than 400 million documents, which reaches over 250 million monthly active users. The team’s remit covers who contributes the content, how well we understand it, and how it reaches users. You will report to the Senior Manager, Data Analytics, and work embedded alongside Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering partners. The role is open at the Senior and Lead levels, and we will level based on the experience you bring. At the Senior level you own analytical workstreams within a defined area. At the Lead level you also set the measurement strategy for the area, take on the most open-ended problems, and raise the bar for the analysts around you.

**Mandate.** Make it possible to say with confidence what is in the corpus, where it falls short of what users look for, and whether enrichment is making content easier to find and use, with numbers that stay comparable as content sources, models, and pipelines change.

**Core philosophy.** A metric definition is a shared artifact. We care about documentation, versioning, and data quality as much as the readout on top, because a number that quietly breaks upstream is worse than no number at all.

**About you**
-------------

* You are at your best when the question is not yet well formed. You look at an incomplete picture, work out what matters, and produce an answer a product team can act on, with the limits of the evidence stated plainly.
* You are equally comfortable as the strategist and the analyst. You can size an opportunity, model its return, write the SQL behind the metric, and defend the number in a room full of product and executive leaders.
* You are skeptical by default. When a metric moves sharply, your instinct is to find the field or pipeline that changed before you write the narrative.
* You are pragmatic. You ask what the right next version is, and you use AI where it creates measurable value.
* You communicate early and plainly, and you write things down. Methodology and metric documentation are part of the deliverable.

**You will**
------------

* Build measurement for content understanding. Define how we measure classification and metadata coverage, accuracy, and the effect of enrichment on discovery and engagement.
* Own analytics for content supply and generate insights on where the corpus falls short: size the gap between user demand and the corpus, estimate the value of closing it, and help prioritize where to invest, using the same market sizing, segmentation, and ROI methods applied in go-to-market analysis.
* Partner with Product Managers on strategy and roadmap. Translate product bets into success and guardrail metrics, size opportunities, and make trade-offs explicit.
* Design and read experiments (A/B tests and other methods) for content-related product changes, from hypothesis through analysis and readout.
* Define and maintain the KPIs, metric definitions, and dashboards for the content domain, and work with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering on instrumentation and data quality so that metrics stay consistent over time.

With over 50 years of serving the creative community, Adorama has grown from a beloved New York City camera store into the world's only full-service destination for photo, video, and electronics. **What You'll Do**

  

The Inventory Planning & Data Analyst will combine hands-on inventory planning, SQL, business intelligence, and reporting automation to improve product availability, strengthen purchasing decisions, and optimize inventory investment.

Reporting to the Head of Inventory and Demand Planning and working directly with Merchants, you will investigate inventory, demand, and supply issues, identify root causes, and turn findings into actionable SKU-level recommendations. This role offers direct exposure to initiatives in forecast optimization, warehouse distribution, lead time, and excess inventory management, with opportunities to improve how the team uses data and reduce recurring manual work.

* Merchant Support and Inventory Decisions

* Replenishment and PO Execution
  + Review daily replenishment and PO needs against established inventory and WOS targets, run-rate, lead time, available inventory, open POs, backorders, and demand trends to control purchasing and avoid excess inventory.
  + Validate system recommendations before execution, especially for high-velocity, high-value, long-lead-time items and SKUs with demand spikes or overstock risk.
  + Release purchase orders within approved authority and follow up with vendors on past-due POs, delivery changes, and supply constraints.
  + Monitor backorders and stockout risk; escalate issues affecting availability, inventory exposure, or merchant goals and track corrective actions through resolution.

* BI Dashboards and Planning Analytics
  + Independently build, maintain, and enhance inventory and planning dashboards in Looker, including data preparation, calculated metrics, filters, and reporting validation.
  + Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, join, aggregate, and validate sales, demand, inventory, item master, and PO data.
  + Monitor dashboard refreshes and reporting accuracy; reconcile outputs with source data and troubleshoot discrepancies with BI and technical partners.
  + Automate recurring reporting and build exception dashboards that prioritize stockout risk, aged inventory, overstock, backorders, past-due POs, demand anomalies, and data gaps; highlight affected SKUs, investigation priorities, recommended actions, and follow-up owners.
  + Maintain reporting that monitors inventory, WOS, and aged inventory against established targets; verify their correct application in replenishment and PO review, investigate variances, and recommend corrective actions for approval.
  + Support approved initiatives in forecast optimization, warehouse distribution and transfers, slow-moving and excess inventory reporting, and lead time and customer ETA reporting through data validation, analysis, and follow-up.

* Root Cause Analysis and Planning Data Accuracy
  + Work with Merchants and Item Master to keep planning-related item fields accurate and updated promptly; identify missing, outdated, or incorrect attributes affecting replenishment and reporting.
  + Follow up on item setup and planning feed issues that create inaccurate recommendations, reporting gaps, or poor inventory decisions.
  + Investigate flagged exceptions involving aged inventory, overstock, past-due POs, backorders, planning overrides, unusual demand, and data gaps to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions.
  + Perform root-cause analysis to identify demand shifts, vendor delays, lead time changes, PO timing issues, item setup errors, or execution gaps; recommend practical corrective actions.
  + Account for promotions, one-time sales spikes, new items, vendor transitions, and opportunity buys when evaluating planning recommendations.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration and Process Improvement

  + Coordinate with Vendors, Item Master, Warehouse Operations, Finance, and BI to resolve inventory issues; own related JIRA tickets from intake through closure.

new_jobs.title: Lead Solutions Analyst - Data Catalog
new_jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Are you ready to lead at the intersection of data strategy, governance, and enterprise technology delivery? At JPMorganChase, we believe that the right data — governed well, delivered reliably, and made accessible — is a competitive advantage. This is your opportunity to shape that future.

As a Lead Solutions Analyst at JPMorganChase within the Corporate Data and Analytics Services team, you will play a pivotal role in advancing the firm's data strategy by designing and delivering enterprise-scale data solutions across the Corporate Technology organization. You will drive the execution of key data initiatives — including the Corporate Data Catalog, Data Lineage, Entitlements, and Data Quality frameworks — while collaborating with engineering teams, senior stakeholders, and Chief Data Officers to ensure high-quality, accessible, and reliable data assets. Your work will directly support the firm's vision of a self-service, fully observable data platform that embraces data mesh and data product principles, enabling domain-driven ownership and consistent data management at scale.

**Job responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of regulatory technology programs with regulator-reportable commitments, embedding control and evidence requirements into milestone exit criteria to ensure programs remain continuously audit-ready
* Own and operate a single intake and prioritization model across multiple competing senior stakeholder organizations, converting ad-hoc demand into a published, predictable roadmap with accountable delivery cadence
* Drive on-time milestone delivery against committed dates by managing agile delivery rhythms with engineering teams and proactively resolving cross-team dependencies and delivery risks
* Influence and secure engineering capacity and resources from teams outside direct reporting lines, negotiating scope trade-offs directly with Chief Data Officers and senior leadership
* Apply deep expertise in metadata management, data lineage, data governance lifecycle, data contracts, data tiering, and industry catalog standards to shape platform direction and ensure alignment with firmwide standards
* Instrument and analyze platform usage signals to diagnose adoption blockers, re-sequence roadmaps in response, and drive measurable enterprise-scale adoption through roadshows, enablement sessions, and self-serve onboarding materials
* Own the executive narrative for a multi-stakeholder platform, running senior governance forums and reporting milestone and risk status to senior leadership and regulatory and audit stakeholders
* Partner with engineering leads on sprint planning and backlog refinement to ensure roadmap commitments are reflected in sprint scope and delivery risks are resolved proactively
* Advance the firm's data mesh and data product strategy by fostering domain-driven data ownership, enabling self-service data platforms, and treating data as a product to ensure quality and reliability

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on solutions analysis concepts and 5+ years applied experience
* Proven track record delivering technology programs with regulatory reporting obligations, including embedding audit-ready controls and evidence requirements into program delivery frameworks
* Demonstrated experience running a structured demand intake and prioritization model across multiple senior stakeholder organizations, with accountability for end-to-end agile delivery
* Experience influencing at the Managing Director level and above, securing resources from teams outside direct reporting lines and negotiating scope trade-offs with senior data leadership
* Deep working knowledge of metadata management, data lineage, data governance lifecycle, data contracts, and industry catalog standards such as DCAT and DPROD
* Proven ability to drive measurable platform adoption at enterprise scale, including diagnosing adoption blockers and leading enablement programs for technical and executive audiences
* Strong executive communication skills with experience owning governance reporting, running senior forums, and framing complex trade-offs for leadership decision-making

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience with AI-ready data product enablement and familiarity with data mesh principles and domain-driven data ownership models
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as BCBS 239 or equivalent regulator-reportable data governance standards
* Experience collaborating with engineering teams on sprint planning and backlog refinement to align roadmap commitments with delivery execution
* Knowledge of data catalog, data quality, data entitlements, and data retention and destruction frameworks in a large-scale enterprise environment
* Background working within a federated technology organization, coordinating across multiple lines of business or technology domains to deliver shared platform capabilities

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. new_jobs.title: Insights & Analytics Lead - North America
new_jobs.description:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

**How does this role contribute to our collective success?**  
Data, analytics and AI are critical enablers of AXIS' strategic ambitions. The Insights & Analytics Lead – North America will be a hands-on technical leader who turns business questions into high-quality insights, analytical solutions and clear recommendations for North American underwriting teams.  
This role is responsible for translating business requirements into well-defined data, analytics, data science and AI requirements. You will explore and analyse large and complex data sets, identify trends and opportunities, determine the most appropriate analytical approach, and communicate conclusions in ways that support better, faster and more informed decisions.  
Working within an agile delivery model, you will partner closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Architects and Technology experts to design, test and deliver solutions that are practical, scalable and aligned to measurable business outcomes.  
Reporting to the Insights & Analytics Director – North America, you will combine technical depth, business understanding and strong delivery skills. You will provide day-to-day technical leadership on initiatives while remaining personally involved in analysis, solution design and the development of analytical outputs.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Translate Business Needs into Analytical and AI Requirements  
  Partner with North American underwriting and business teams to understand business objectives, decision points, pain points and opportunities.
* Translate business requirements into clear data, analytics, data science and AI requirements, including hypotheses, data needs, analytical methods, success measures and delivery acceptance criteria.
* Challenge and refine requests to ensure the proposed solution addresses the underlying business problem and is proportionate to the value and complexity involved.
* Recommend the right approach for each problem, whether descriptive or diagnostic analysis, reporting and visualisation, predictive modelling, machine learning, generative AI or workflow automation.
* Deliver Hands-On Analysis and Insight
* Frame analytical questions, develop hypotheses, select appropriate methods and validate findings before drawing conclusions.
* Convert analysis into practical recommendations, explaining the business implications, limitations and actions required.
* Identify opportunities where advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities could improve underwriting effectiveness, portfolio management, operational efficiency or customer outcomes.
* Shape solution concepts and technical requirements, including use cases, user journeys, required data, model or AI behaviour, controls, evaluation criteria and expected business value.
* Rapidly prototype analytical and AI-enabled solutions to test feasibility and value before wider development.
* Work with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to support model development, testing, validation, deployment and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Ensure solutions are explainable, fit-for-purpose and developed in line with AXIS data, AI governance, security and responsible AI requirements.
* Work as an active member of cross-functional agile delivery teams, partnering closely with Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Architects, Technology experts and business product owners.
* Contribute technical analysis, solution design, backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, demonstrations, testing and retrospectives.
* Promote reuse of common data products, analytical methods, models and components across the wider Insights & Analytics community.
* Define and track outcome-focused success measures, using feedback and performance evidence to improve solutions after release.
* Explain analytical and AI concepts in clear business language and build confidence in the appropriate use of data-driven insights.

**Success Measures**  
Success in this role will be measured through:

* Delivered solutions contribute to measurable improvements in underwriting effectiveness, portfolio insight, operational efficiency or customer outcomes.
* Solutions use the right level of analytical sophistication for the problem and are practical, explainable and fit-for-purpose.
* Strong collaboration and trusted working relationships are established across North America business teams, Data & Analytics and Technology.
* Insights and solutions are adopted and used within day-to-day business decisions and workflows.
* Analytical assets, methods and components are documented, reusable and continuously improved.

**About you:**  
We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table. While there are qualifications and experiences we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might help you fulfil this role and contribute to our goals

The World Economic Forum, committed to improving the state of the world, is the international organization for public-private cooperation. The Forum engages the foremost political, business and other leaders of society to shape global, regional and industry agendas.

**Why we are recruiting**

As a partnership organization and through the Business Engagement teams, the World Economic Forum engages the private sector to address industry, regional and systemic issues. Partners benefit from and contribute to the global knowledge base through working closely with the Forum to set the intellectual agenda of Forum gatherings, drive the insight agenda of its publications and steer the impact of its initiatives.

The Global Industries Team is responsible for building and managing the Forum global Industry Communities and for the strategic engagement of Forum Partners from North America and Europe across Industry Communities, the Forum Centres and our Forum events.

We are currently seeking an Account Analyst who will be tasked with supporting Account Managers to enhance engagement with Partner organizations and improve partner experience across Forum activities. The Account Analyst will focus on business engagement operations, facilitating efficient day-to-day business administration with a strong focus on operational excellence and data quality.

**Reporting Lines and Interactions**

The Account Analyst will interact with the Account Managers within the team, and across multiple teams ranging from Finance, Contract Management to Industry, Centre and Government engagement groups. The person will report to the Director, Financial Services Industries.

**Main responsibilities**

* **Account management support:** Facilitate and deliver onboarding for Partners in close collaboration with Account Managers - prepare an agenda for the meeting; coordinate internally with relevant teams; prepare relevant documents/presentations; support with logistics; and when appropriate onboard/introduce digital tools to partners.
* **Event related support**: Track registrations for the full team and provide overview on status; support registration and event related queries on logistics from partners; conduct first level of account checks before handing over to the Account Manager; collate nominations from Account Managers for select communities; collate shortlist of bilateral meetings from Account Managers on the team for the Forum’s Chief Business Officer, President and Co-chairs and other Managing Directors, schedule bilateral meetings and build briefing documents (with supervision of Account Managers and Head of Region).
* **Data quality management:** Maintain accurate account data for the portfolio, liaise with Business Services to address Salesforce issues; ensure digital tools are being efficiently deployed within the team.
* **Contract and invoice management**: accurate and timely contract management in compliance with internal policies and procedures; liaise with Finance and Accounts Receivables team to reduce errors in billing automation processes, implying minimal intervention from Account Managers; manage invoice delivery, corrections, track overdue invoices, work with Account Managers to identify action to be taken to reduce receivables.
* **Day-to-day operational and administrative support**: the Account Associate will be responsible for the operational efficiency of the team - manage operations for team meetings; support the planning and execution of special projects, including top Forum leadership; track timelines and milestones to deliver on the team’s objectives, using the appropriate CRM and operational tools and processes; closely monitor and evaluate key industry developments, media reports and policy changes that impact the larger ecosystem.

**Success in this role will be measured by:**

* **Operational performance**: Consistent, accurate, and self-directed management of partner engagement activities
* **Data integrity**: Tangible improvements in data accuracy and governance
* **Business enablement**: Proactive problem-solving leading to fewer support requests from business teams
* **Productivity gains**: Clear reduction in Account Manager time spent on operational overhead
* **Execution discipline**: Reliable delivery of team operations on time and in line with agreed SLAs
* **Stakeholder impact**: Strong, trusted collaboration with stakeholders, reflected in quality of engagement and feedback

**Preferred Requirements and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business, Economics, Management or another relevant field.

* 1+ years of full-time experience in a business development or relationship management role in a fast-changing professional environment preferred. Working knowledge and experience of sales cycle management, account management, or market research is a must.
* Ability to build and maintain positive relationship with partners that enable the Forum to drive new business opportunities

* Excellent organizational, project and time management skills, a strong work ethic, and high attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with and manage expectations of senior stakeholders

IRIS Environmental Laboratories is an accredited environmental testing laboratory in Union, New Jersey. We serve environmental consultants, property managers, schools, healthcare facilities, and contractors. We are expanding our metals program and are looking for a senior analyst to own it.

**Position Summary**  
The Senior ICP-OES Analyst leads the lab’s inorganic metals program on an Agilent 5110 SVDV ICP-OES. The role covers drinking water, non-potable water, and solid, wipe, and air-filter matrices under EPA Methods 200.5, 200.7, and SW-846 6010D. You will run and review routine analyses, maintain method compliance under TNI/NELAP and AIHA-LAP quality systems, keep the instrument performing, and train and mentor metals staff.

* Prepare samples by acid and microwave digestion, including EPA 3050B, 3051A, and 200.7 aqueous preparation.
* Optimize and maintain instrument conditions: wavelength and background-correction selection, plasma and nebulizer settings, viewing mode, internal standards, and rinse and uptake times.
* Troubleshoot drift, carryover, contamination, spectral interference, and sample-introduction problems, and perform routine and preventive maintenance.
* Conduct and document method studies, including MDLs, LOQs, DOCs, linear dynamic range, interelement correction, and spectral-interference studies.
* Analyze proficiency-testing samples and evaluate the results.

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in chemistry, analytical chemistry, environmental science, or a related field.

* Routine experience performing EPA 200.7 and/or 6010 series methods. EPA 200.5 experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with acid and/or microwave digestion of water and solid matrices.
* Working knowledge of TNI/NELAP, ISO/IEC 17025, or equivalent quality systems.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot instruments and resolve QC failures independently.
* Strong documentation habits and attention to detail.
* Ability to work on-site in Union, NJ.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Agilent ICP-OES and ICP Expert software.
* ICP-MS experience (EPA 200.8 / 6020).

One of the first tactical initiatives for this role will be building out our store sales performance and replenishment analytics. As our retail showroom footprint grows alongside e-commerce, we need clear visibility into how each location sells, where availability is constraining sales, and how inventory should be allocated and replenished across the network.  
  
You will own the analysis that establishes that visibility and turns it into a repeatable replenishment approach. We are a hands-on, code-forward planning organization. Our forecasting, replenishment, and reporting run on a Python-native analytics stack rather than on manual spreadsheets, and every member of the team is expected to work fluently in SQL, Python, and BI tooling. This is how we operate, and it is central to how this role creates value.
